description: Political Galaxy Index manifest – country / ideology blocks that contain party scores and (optionally) timeline eras
notes: Folder names under Index/Parties and Index/Timeline are case-sensitive (Title-Case with hyphens).
scores.json keys are lowercase (1a, c5b, …). The data layer normalises them to the UI form (1A, C5B).
Core 1A may be a dual object {endos, xenos} for certain communist entities; the UI supports both single numbers and dual scores.
